Class LocalProjectProperties

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.project.LocalProjectProperties
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProjectProperties
public final class LocalProjectProperties extends Object implements ProjectProperties
Extension for LocalProjects. This class will be used to load, access, modify and save project properties in the form of a JSON object.
